verdict.rationale: Supabase docs confirm automatic daily backups for paid plans (supabase-docs-11), but there's no documented UI/API for viewing or configuring the backup schedule, nor any described self-serve restore workflow in the evidence pack. Independent reporting (Val Town/HN) found Supabase's nightly pg_dump-based backups were taking the database fully offline every night due to write contention, which the CEO confirmed and said would prompt a move to PITR — a concrete hands-on contradiction of reliable, invisible automatic backups. Missing for 10: documented schedule visibility/configuration UI, a documented self-serve restore flow, and confirmation the offline-backup issue has been resolved.
